one_liner: Hosted ecommerce platform with merchant storefront, products, orders and checkout.
access_notes: Create an app in the Dev Dashboard and obtain access tokens via OAuth/token exchange or client credentials; protected customer data needs approval.
mcp_note: Shopify-hosted MCP servers for storefront/catalog, cart, checkout and Customer Accounts (shopify.dev/docs/agents, mcp.shop.com); no Admin/merchant-management MCP seen. @shopify/dev-mcp (AI Toolkit) is docs/schema dev tooling only and not counted.
blocker_note: Protected customer data access and public app distribution require Shopify review.
